text: George M. Johnson's All Boys Aren't Blue drew concerns from parents around the country. Flagler County School Board member Jill Woolbright reported to the Sheriff's Office that four copies of the book in the media centers of three district schools violated state obscenity laws. After reviewing the complaint, filed on November 9th, the Sheriff's Office found that no Flagler Schools employee committed criminal wrongdoing by adding the book to school libraries. The community was starkly divided over whether the book constituted pornography. On Wednesday, Nov. 10, the Kansas City Star reported that after the North Kansas City School District removed the book and another from school library shelves, students launched a petition to protest.
meta_description: All Boys Aren't Blue by George M. Johnson: a Flagler County obscenity complaint found no wrongdoing, and North Kansas City removed it from school libraries.
